log.what: First version: research numbers for all eleven default strategies, 30% planning haircut.

Webull's real fee (0.10% + 7% VAT = 0.107%, used as 0.11% per buy and per sell) in every backtest, and lower-cost settings: IBS-dip strategies keep the T-bill half as cash (QLD IBS also dips only below IBS 0.15), metals stay in cash while flat. Each expected return = research return adjusted by the change measured in the bot's backtest; worst falls = the worse of research and bot backtest.
